text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ross briefs Mubarak on results of his talks aimed at saving peace with Arafat and Netanyahu. Ross says that Egypt is playing an important role in the peace process. Moussa says U.S. envoy suggested a few ideas.
- Jordanian foreign minister gives Mubarak message from King Hussein on bilateral ties and developments in the peace process.
- Government to dedicate 99 billion pounds for development of southern Egypt in new five year plan.
- Gulf war compensation payments begin in Cairo and other provinces.
- Finance minister says public sector salaries and pensions to increase by 12 percent in new budget.
